confirmed_bug.description: Explicit movement allowed a node to straddle an unselected comment boundary although placement suggestion refused that geometry.
failures: Explicit movement refuses partial comment entry

repair.visual_review: Nodes remain outside the unselected comment; spacing and links visible. Wide capture is not a text-legibility acceptance.

limitations: Rigid translation does not repair internal spacing or rewire nodes.
Placement optimizes estimated straight boundary wires, not all rendered crossings or global layout.
Selected fixture proves free placement and explicit comment transfer, not automatic selection of every destination or nested-comment topology.
No exhaustive multi-branch, all-node-class or pre-existing backward-wire layout guarantee.
No compile, execution semantics or saved reload tested: this workflow changes positions only.
Undo verified through the editor transaction API; no concurrent user mutation stress test.

checks: Live MCP parameter help and identifier rules
Preview preserves positions and clean package
Rigid translation preserves internal spacing, links and outside positions
Collision, comment-boundary, missing-node, missing-graph and empty-selection refusals
Placement offsets applied exactly with measured forward execution clearance
Undo restores placement, comment and transfer coordinates
workflow_evidence.visual_review: Inspected native capture: execution connections run forward, nodes do not overlap, and unrelated comment remains fixed.

followup_failures.reason: Test expected C++ parameter capitalization instead of actual camel-case MCP schema. Corrected assertion; this was not a tool defect.
Screenshot showed a backward execution hairpin. Placement scored stored node widths instead of measured pin positions. Replaced scoring geometry and added forward-clearance assertion.

quality_review.behavior_and_safety: Shared preflight before transaction; source reviewed for coordinate overflow, comment membership and collision checks. Preview and edit recheck current geometry.
quality_review.code_and_comments: Corrected outdated preview guarantee; documented measured-pin requirement and execution clearance.
quality_review.help_and_english: Live parameter help checked. Empty returned destination now explicitly shows an empty string. Results distinguish preview, unchanged, error and changed; estimates do not claim global optimality.
